# Sidebar Wallet · dsh-sidebar-wallet
**English** | 简体中文
A one-line readout at the far right end of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar account row: **balance** and
**today's spend**. Hover for the details card, click to refresh.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
*Sample data rendered from the component styles — not a screenshot.*
## Features
- **Balance**: the official `GET /user/balance` — uses the saved `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` first, falling b

ack to the signed-in DeepSeek account wallet.
- **Today's spend**: the official Platform usage expor
t (Beijing calendar day, same numbers as the console's Usage page); falls back to a local session-lo

g estimate, marked with `≈`.
- **Hover / click**: hover shows balance, today's spend and request cou
nt, input (hit / miss) tokens, output tokens, cache hit rate, the peak/off-peak countdown, update ti

me and source; click refreshes.
- **Language**: the readout follows the DSH interface language (Chin
ese / English) and switches live with the Language setting.
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.1-rc.1 (tested on 0.2.1-rc.5):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Notes
- The official usage comes from the private Platform web endpoint `api/v0/usage/export` (not a publi
c API): the plugin reads the signed-in account session through DSH's `deepseekAccount.getPlatformSes
sion()`, so no manual token is needed; when it is unavailable the local estimate is used instead and

the readout never goes blank.
- Privacy & security: only two hosts are contacted — `api.deepseek.co
m` (balance) and `platform.deepseek.com` (usage); tokens stay in the Host process memory and are nev
er sent to the browser or written to disk; the only route is a read-only `GET /dsh-sidebar-wallet/st
ate.json` (loopback / same-origin fence). No writes, no telemetry, no third-party runtime dependenci

es.
- Known limits: the official figure covers every API call of the account (any API key or client)
; without a signed-in account only the local estimate is shown; the peak/off-peak and holiday tables
only affect the local estimate and the countdown.
